beats.label: The study
beats.text: About **486,000** adults in China, followed for roughly **9** **years.**
beats.note: Ye et al., Journal of Internal Medicine, Oct 2026

beats.label: Tea vs no tea
beats.text: Regular tea drinkers had about **11%** lower risk of heart and **blood** **vessel** disease.

beats.label: Black vs green
beats.text: **Black** tea showed a more **consistent** link than green.

beats.label: Warm vs burning hot
beats.text: **Moderate** strength looked best. **Burning** **hot** tea was linked to **higher** risk.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: It's **observational,** and experts say it **doesn't** **prove** tea protects your heart. Don't chase **8** **cups.**
